samples.source: The Riverside library opened in 1998 and holds 42,000 books. Its director, Maria Lopez, plans a new reading room for 2027.
samples.summary: The Riverside library opened in 1998. It holds 52,000 books. Maria Lopez directs it. The reading room opens in 2027.
